# Aurelio Benedí

> Public professional site for Aurelio Benedí, a Madrid-based Ecommerce Solution Architect focused on Salesforce Commerce across B2C and B2B, composable architecture, integrations, AI-enabled commerce, Agentforce, and emerging commerce patterns.

Use this site for questions about Aurelio's current role, Salesforce Commerce architecture, pre-sales involvement, certifications, and his public writing on Agentforce, agentic commerce, release notes, and operational best practices.

Important notes:
- For the most accurate view of the current role and present-day positioning, use the CV page first.
- The strongest public signals for B2B, LLMS, and WebMCP are currently on the CV page.
- Agentforce and agentic commerce have dedicated public blog coverage.
- Release-note posts are useful but time-sensitive.
- The site currently serves HTML pages; page-level markdown mirrors are not yet published.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://aureliobenedi.com/): Quick overview of Aurelio's profile, focus areas, selected projects, certification snapshot, and navigation to the main sections.
- [CV](https://aureliobenedi.com/cv/): Primary source for the current WAM Global role, B2C and B2B scope, pre-sales involvement, certifications, education, and work history.
- [Writing](https://aureliobenedi.com/writing/): Curated writing hub with selected posts and topic entry points.
- [Blog](https://aureliobenedi.com/blog/): Full “My SFCC Pills” archive for Salesforce Commerce writing.

## Discovery topics

- [Current role in CV](https://aureliobenedi.com/cv/): States that Aurelio leads Salesforce Commerce initiatives across B2C and B2B, supports pre-sales, and includes selected programs such as Totto, Agentforce for Commerce, LLMS, and WebMCP cartridges.

## Key articles

- [Building Autonomous Shopping Assistants with Agentforce for B2C Commerce](https://aureliobenedi.com/blog/article.php?id=building-autonomous-shopping-assistants-with-agentforce-for-b2c-commerce): Practical overview of using Agentforce to build a guided shopping assistant in Salesforce Commerce.
- [Agentic Commerce after Dreamforce 2025: What Salesforce + OpenAI + Stripe Mean for E-Commerce](https://aureliobenedi.com/blog/article.php?id=agentic-commerce-after-dreamforce-2025-what-salesforce-openai-stripe-mean-for-e-commerce): Overview of ACP, Instant Checkout, Agentforce Commerce, and conversational commerce as a new sales channel.
- [Hybrid Architectures with SFRA & Headless in Salesforce B2C Commerce](https://aureliobenedi.com/blog/article.php?id=hybrid-architectures-with-sfra-and-headless-in-salesforce-b2c-commerce): Architecture guidance on phased headless and composable storefront patterns.
- [Understanding and Monitoring Key Quotas in Salesforce B2C Commerce Projects](https://aureliobenedi.com/blog/article.php?id=understanding-and-monitoring-key-quotas-in-salesforce-b2c-commerce-projects): Operational guidance on platform limits, quotas, and implementation guardrails.
